curation.canonicalNameEvidence: To measure it, we propose \textit{ZDPShift}, a benchmark of $21{,}495$ stereo pairs from seven cinematographer-authored open movies, each frame rendered at five zero-disparity-plane positions with dense signed ground truth.
curation.decisionReason: The benchmark is clearly defined with a stable scoring contract, but no public dataset, code, or submission path is supplied in the provided evidence, so it cannot be published yet.

evaluationEvidence.reuse: Training on supervision synthesized from SceneFlow, which adds no new data or parameters, keeps the error flat across the signed range.
evaluationEvidence.scoring: Six state-of-the-art image and video stereo matching models collapse once the plane moves. On identical scene content, FoundationStereo goes from $2.24$ px EPE to $75.33$px, with every backbone leaving roughly half of all pixels exceeding a three-pixel disparity error.
